reviews.text: Not only did Clearly Superior Pool have the best price point out of all our estimates, they conducted the refurbishing of our pool in a proficient and professional manner.  All of our concerns and questions where answered to our satisfaction.  Our pool is now more moderate with an up to date look. We can wholeheartedly recommend Jason and his team for any pool project!
reviews.author: Silvia Stoudemire

reviews.text:
We chose to have Jason with Clearly Superior design and build our pool.  So glad we did!!  It has been a fantastic experience!  We did our due diligence, contacted other highly rated pool builders, had them come out, give us a design and quote.  We also spoke with others who used Jason and Clearly Superior to build their pools.  Not only were they happy with Jason's pool building skills, but also his attention AFTER he built their pools.
During the hugely unprecedented winter freeze, Jason went above and beyond, making sure his pool clients were taken care of.  Many others lost their equipment, but not Jason's clients.
Jason was the only one who took the time to listen to what we actually wanted, drew out what we were telling him in real time, made adjustments, told us what was possible, not possible and why.  He had detailed knowledge that only comes from vast experience.  This is our first pool, so that was incredibly important to us.  He let us know up front if something was going to be problematic and costly - like digging into very rocky soil.  Not only was Jason's design better and more in line with what we wanted (and spent much time tweeking and re-tweeking), his prices were much more reasonable at a time when Covid had created shortages and upcharges.  Jason also takes care of our pool cleaning and maintenance.  He does a great job, educates us, works with us, and I can't imagine having anyone else doing it.  Building a pool is scary, and Jason has defintely made this a great experience for our family!  HIGHLY  recommed!
reviews.author: Angelia Denise

reviews.text: Jason and his team were great. They had the best quotes and the best service. My pool had a lot of issues and they were able to handle them all. They replaced the tile line, installed new spa coping, rebuilt a pump motor, fixed the electrical wiring for the spa light, replaced plumbing that was leaking, replaced a valve that was spraying water everywhere, replaced fittings and lines that were cracked. Jason was very responsive, showed exactly what the issues were and explained in detail. You can tell when a contractor is just trying to make money and this wasn't the case. He genuinely wanted to fix the issues without breaking your bank. I will be using this company from now on.
reviews.author: Aimee Hanners

reviews.text: Clearly Superior Pools did an amazing job fixing our pool.  From start to finish we were kept informed every step of the way, everything was explained clearly and plainly.  They fixed our damaged deck and resurfaced the pool with a beautiful finish.  We are very happy and can’t wait to enjoy it as soon as possible!!
reviews.author: Kelly Heckle

reviews.text: We had a amazing pool building experience with Clearly Superior Pools. Start to finish Jason and Beth were there for any and all things we needed, changes or questions. They are very honest and trustworthy and made our pool dreams a reality! Highly recommend CSP!
reviews.author: Bobby Barry

reviews.text: Jason and his team were amazing!  We discussed our idea/desires for our backyard oasis (pool, firepit, outdoor kitchen, and outdoor covered seating area), and he took it and made it happen!  The crews that came to work were always so respectful, cleaned up after themselves, and always on time!  Jason was very open in communication on next steps and walked us through the pool’s ins and outs!  Overall the whole process from beginning to end was great and amazing!  Looking forward to enjoying our beautiful backyard!
reviews.author: Ashley Purnell

reviews.text: We had a great experience throughout our pool build. Jason and Beth were amazing to work with and really took our lazy river pool idea and made it an amazing getaway! Highly recommend Clearly Superior Pools !
reviews.author: Carlos Arroyo

reviews.text: The contractor was efficient and knowledgeable.  The process - efficient and smooth. The pool is fabulous, and the family enjoys it every weekend. 😀 👙🏊‍♀️ Thank you for a wonderful experience.
reviews.author: L. R.

authentic_signals: Specific project details mentioned (refurbishing, tile line, spa coping, lazy river)
Mention of owner/crew names (Jason, Beth, team)
Varied writing styles and project types
